title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow autorollback and observability
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: increase reliability of progressive rollouts (canary / A-B / shadow) by making rollback decisions multi-metric, time-window aware, and observable. Previous behavior relied on single-metric instantaneous thresholds which led to noisy rollbacks and long incident triage.

What this PR does: 1) Adds a metric-driven autorollback policy that supports multiple metrics (latency P99, error-rate, model-quality eval score) with configurable weightings and decay windows. 2) Implements a staged-evaluation engine that evaluates canary/A-B/shadow traffic over sliding windows and supports a configurable sample-rate for shadow pipelines. 3) Enhances tracing and dashboards: emits per-rollout decision traces, contributing metric deltas, and a human-readable decision rationale to the rollout event stream. 4) Provides a new dry-run mode and a "soft-fallback" path that automatically reduces traffic to the incumbent variant before fully rolling back. 5) Adds safety checks for cross-region and multi-tier deployments to avoid cascading rollbacks.

Design notes: - Rollout evaluator consolidates metrics from Prometheus (latency/error) and our quality pipeline (prompt-set evals) into a single decision score computed as a weighted sum. - Evaluation windows support exponentially decaying weights so older anomalies reduce influence over time. - Soft-fallback reduces target weight by configurable step (default 20%) and pauses further adjustments for a cooldown period (default 5m) to give transient systems time to recover. - Decision events are emitted to the rollout_events topic (augment existing protobuf with a short rationale string). - CI feature-flag gating: feature gated behind rollout.autorollback.v2 (off by default) and enabled in staging clusters for 48h before progressive rollout to prod.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests for evaluator logic and thresholding added. - Integration tests simulate canary with injected latency/error profiles and verify correct soft-fallback then full rollback behavior. - End-to-end smoke tests in perf-canary env with real traffic replay. - Added new dashboards and an alert that triggers when automatic rollbacks exceed a rate threshold.

Operational notes: - Ops runbook updated with investigative steps that include looking at rollout_event rationale. - Backwards compatibility: existing rollout configs without new policy fields behave as before. - Migration: protobuf schema bump handled with compatibility-preserving field numbers.

Related: Linear ENG-9534 (autorollback v2), ENG-9621 (rollout observability).
